name: cn_reranking_bench
description: cn_reranking_bench measures a model's ability to rerank candidate documents/passages for Chinese information retrieval queries, evaluating how well models place the most relevant items near the top of a ranked list. It focuses on ranking quality rather than generation, using standard IR relevance judgments as ground truth. The benchmark is intended for evaluating reranking models and ranking modules in Chinese-language retrieval pipelines.
reputation: Niche dataset with limited but growing use among researchers working on Chinese information retrieval and reranking.
